## Checklist

See CONTRIBUTING.md in the repository root.

- [ ] `cargo run -q -- fmt` and `cargo run -q -- check`: 0 errors, and any warnings explained above
- [ ] Every new link has a T1 or T2 source (T3 only for what a subject says about itself) and an exact `quote` I checked against the document
- [ ] Interpretations name whose account they are (`according_to`) and quote that account's own words
- [ ] No labels on people, and nothing that suggests a connection is wrongdoing
- [ ] Family links: one T1 or two independent T1/T2 sources; public figures' kin only, no minors or private relatives
- [ ] Background lines: people only, a living person's own words, nothing inferred
- [ ] A renamed entry keeps its old id in `aliases`
- [ ] Stories: about 45 words a scene, times on the events, quote cards in the speaker's exact words, played with Watch and Listen
- [ ] No sensitive allegation in the title or the commit messages
